prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a sideswipe while changing lanes in Conroe, Texas, and has whiplash. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1397; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for agreeing to give this recorded statement. Please state your full name for the record.

A: I'd rather not say my full name on the recording. You can call me the claimant.

Q: That's fine. Can you tell me where you were when the accident happened?

A: I was in Conroe, Texas, on the main road heading toward the shopping center near the highway.

Q: What were you doing right before the collision?

A: I was in the right lane and I wanted to move into the left lane to get around a slow truck. I checked my mirror, I thought it was clear, and I started to change lanes.

Q: What happened next?

A: A car in the left lane came up beside me and clipped the side of my vehicle. It pushed me toward the curb and I had to fight the wheel to keep control.

Q: Did you see the other vehicle before it made contact?

A: Not really. I think it was in my blind spot. I didn't see it until the impact.

Q: Did you stop at the scene?

A: Yes, I pulled onto the shoulder and waited for the officer to arrive.

Q: Did you notice any injuries at the time?

A: My neck felt stiff, but I didn't think much of it. By the next morning the pain was in my neck and upper back, and I had headaches. I've been seeing a doctor since then for whiplash.

Q: Are you still receiving treatment?

A: Yes, I have physical therapy twice a week and my doctor has me on a muscle relaxant.

Q: Thank you. Is there anything else you'd like to add?

A: Only that I want to be sure my account is recorded accurately, and I'm willing to provide my medical records.

Q: Thank you. This concludes the statement.
